info.title: Shillinq Register
info.description: Shillinq register v0.7.0: retires the scaffold `example` schema and renames the `Project` slug to `engagement`. Planninq owns `project` as a container for tasks and kanban columns; this one is a consultancy engagement with RJ 270 percentage-of-completion revenue recognition, which is a different entity wearing the same word. Slugs are global on a shared OpenRegister. The schema KEY stays `Project`, so the register.d fragments that extend it by key are unaffected. PREVIOUSLY: Register containing all schemas for the Shillinq application. v0.6.4 — re-authored 31 Dutch schema-level titles (entity display names) to English so manifest-driven UI labels are English-authored; Dutch display is now carried via l10n/nl.json per ADR i18n rule. Previous v0.6.3 — re-authored 254 Dutch schema-property titles (and none renamed keys) to English so manifest-driven UI labels are English-authored; Dutch display is now carried via l10n/nl.json per ADR i18n rule. Previous v0.6.2 — Register containing all schemas for the Shillinq application.

BankConnection.title: Bank Connection
BankConnection.description: A PSD2 AIS bank connection authorising access to one or more bank accounts via an openconnector aggregator source. Credentials live in openconnector; this record carries the consent reference only.

connectionNumber.description: Operator-readable reference for this bank connection.
connectionNumber.title: Connection Number

aggregator.description: PSD2 AIS aggregator providing the connection. Credentials live in the corresponding openconnector Source record.
aggregator.title: Aggregator

aggregatorSourceSlug.description: FK to the openconnector Source slug that holds the aggregator OAuth credentials. shillinq carries this reference only; credentials never land here.
aggregatorSourceSlug.title: Aggregator Source Slug

bankBic.description: BIC/SWIFT code of the bank the connection covers.
bankBic.title: Bank BIC

bankCountry.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code of the bank.
bankCountry.title: Bank Country

bankAccountIban.description: IBAN of the linked bank account.
bankAccountIban.title: Bank Account IBAN

consentReference.description: Aggregator-issued consent identifier returned from the SCA flow. Non-credential metadata — NOT an OAuth token or client secret.
consentReference.title: Consent Reference

consentGrantedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the PSD2 consent was granted.
consentGrantedAt.title: Consent Granted At

consentExpiresAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the PSD2 consent expires. PSD2 mandates SCA renewal every 90 days.
consentExpiresAt.title: Consent Expires At

consentRemainingDays.description: Derived (do not set directly): days until the PSD2 consent expires. Negative when already expired. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
consentRemainingDays.title: Consent Remaining Days

lastSyncAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the most recent successful transaction pull.
lastSyncAt.title: Last Sync At

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this bank connection.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

pending.label: Pending

active.label: Active

expiring.label: Expiring

expired.label: Expired

revoked.label: Revoked

activate.label: Activate connection

expire.label: Mark as expired

renew.label: Renew consent

onEnterExpiring.description: Notify configured recipient 14 days before consent expires.

shillinq-bank-transaction-polling.name: Bank transaction polling
shillinq-bank-transaction-polling.description: Pulls transactions from the PSD2 aggregator via the openconnector source slug, normalises the aggregator JSON to CAMT.053 XML, attaches the XML via docudesk, and creates a BankStatement record per active BankConnection. Runs 4× daily. No BankPollingJob extends TimedJob.

BankStatement.title: Bank Statement
BankStatement.description: A CAMT.053 bank statement generated by the scheduled transaction polling workflow from aggregator data. The generated XML is attached via docudesk.

bankConnectionId.description: Reference to the PSD2 BankConnection that generated this statement.
bankConnectionId.title: Bank Connection ID

statementFormat.description: CAMT XML format version of the generated statement.
statementFormat.title: Statement Format

statementDate.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the statement generation run.
statementDate.title: Statement Date

statementAttachmentUri.description: docudesk attachment URI referencing the generated CAMT.053 XML document.
statementAttachmentUri.title: Statement Attachment URI

transactionCount.description: Number of transactions included in this statement.
transactionCount.title: Transaction Count

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this statement.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

onNewStatement.description: Notify the configured bank-connection operator when a new statement is available. Declarative fan-out per ADR-031; no BankNotificationService.

GLTransaction.title: GL Transaction
GLTransaction.description: A double-entry general-ledger posting header. Owns the lifecycle and the balance invariant; child GLLine rows carry the debit/credit amounts.

transactionNumber.description: Sequential transaction number unique per administration + fiscal year.
transactionNumber.title: Transaction Number

postingDate.description: Effective accounting date of the posting.
postingDate.title: Posting Date

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod record (T3 introduces the schema; T1 accepts any string). Auto-resolved on the post transition.
periodId.title: Period ID

currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency for this posting.
currency.title: Currency

sourceReference.description: External document number (invoice no., bank statement ref, asset repair ID, etc.).
sourceReference.title: Source Reference

state.description: Lifecycle state. draft: under construction; posted: immutable and in trial balance; reversed: superseded by a compensating transaction.
state.title: State

journalEntryId.description: Back-reference to the JournalEntry that materialised this posting, if any.
journalEntryId.title: Journal Entry ID

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this posting.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

reversesTransactionId.description: FK to the GLTransaction that this transaction reverses. Required on the reversed transaction for the reversal guard.
reversesTransactionId.title: Reverses Transaction ID

lines.description: Inverse of GLLine.transactionId; back-reference populated by OpenRegister.
lines.title: Lines

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Under construction. Lines may be added, edited, or deleted.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Immutable. Header and lines are locked; appears in trial balance (T3).

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Superseded by a compensating transaction. Excluded from balance aggregations but remains queryable for audit.

post.label: Post transaction
post.description: Transition draft posting to posted state. Enforces balance invariant and account-state guard. After balance check passes, evaluates active per-posting AllocationRule records + design D2.

actions.description: Evaluate all active AllocationRule records with cadence=per-posting whose sourceAccountPattern matches a line in this transaction. Emits additional balanced GLLine rows distributing source amounts per the rule targets.

reverse.label: Reverse transaction
reverse.description: Mark this transaction as reversed. A compensating GLTransaction referencing this one via reversesTransactionId must exist.

nivraBestanden.description: NIVRA-bestand audit-trail export for a given period. Projects every GLTransaction header, its GLLine rows, every audit event for those transactions, the period trial-balance totals, and the chart-of-accounts in effect. Output via docudesk XML template (nivra-bestand-{standardVersion}.xml). Declarative per ADR-031 — no NivraExportService.

auditExport.description: Every NIVRA-bestand export writes an immutable audit event with operator id, period id, document URI, and SHA-256. Enforced by OR's audit engine — NOT by app-local logging.

steekproef.description: Deterministic random sample of GLTransaction records for a period. Given periodId, sampleSize, and seed, returns the same sampleSize GLTransaction ids in the same order on every run with the same seed. Exportable as a docudesk werkpapier. If OR's aggregation engine cannot guarantee seed reproducibility across versions, the implementing cycle falls back to OCA\Shillinq\Audit\SteekproefSampler:sample per ADR-031 exception path (single-method ~20-LOC PHP).

auditExport.description: Every steekproef export writes an immutable audit event. Enforced by OR's audit engine.

ledenraadpleging.description: Redacted slice of period postings for raadsleden review. Fields tagged redactFor: raadsleden are replaced by a stable SHA-256 hash. Default redacted fields: GLTransaction.description (free-text), GLLine.description (free-text), GLLine.subLedgerRef (AP/AR sub-ledger reference). Numeric and account-code fields remain intact.

fields.description: Free-text transaction description may carry personal data (e.g. 'Salaris Jan Bakker maart 2026'). Replaced by SHA-256 hash.
Line-level free-text description. Replaced by SHA-256 hash.
AP/AR sub-ledger reference may identify natural persons. Replaced by SHA-256 hash.

auditExport.description: Every ledenraadpleging export writes an immutable audit event. Enforced by OR's audit engine.

GLLine.title: GL Line
GLLine.description: A debit-or-credit line within a GLTransaction, encoding the polarity in the side enum. Extended with eliminationFlag to support GR consolidation.

transactionId.description: Reference to the parent GLTransaction (holds its object UUID).
transactionId.title: Transaction ID

accountNumber.description: FK to Account.accountNumber (bookkeeping-chart-of-accounts). A business key, not an object identifier — the referenced Account must be in lifecycleState active for the post transition to succeed.
accountNumber.title: Account Number

accountRef.description: Reference to the Account (holds its object UUID). accountNumber RGS code retained.
accountRef.title: Account Ref

side.description: Debit or credit polarity; amount is always non-negative.
side.title: Side

amount.description: Non-negative posting amount in the transaction's currency.
amount.title: Amount

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code. Must equal the parent GLTransaction.currency (T1 single-currency invariant).
currency.title: Currency

periodId.description: FK to the FiscalPeriod. Auto-resolved by the lifecycle engine on the GLTransaction.post transition.
periodId.title: Period ID

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear this line belongs to, denormalised from the parent GLTransaction.fiscalYearId so line-level roll-ups can group by year. GLLine declared no fiscal-year property at all, so every aggregation grouping on it put all rows into ONE null bucket — a plausible total, not an error. periodId is NOT a substitute: a period is a finer grain than a year. Backfilled from the parent transaction by BackfillGlLineFiscalYear.
fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal Year ID

subLedgerType.description: Sub-ledger discriminator; T2 owns the actual sub-ledger registers.
subLedgerType.title: Sub Ledger Type

subLedgerRef.description: FK into the sub-ledger when subLedgerType is not none.
subLedgerRef.title: Sub Ledger Ref

costCenter.description: Cost-center or department code for allocation reporting.
costCenter.title: Cost Center

eliminationFlag.description: When true, excludes this line from the consolidated trial-balance and financial-statement aggregations. Used to eliminate inter-GR transactions from consolidated views.
eliminationFlag.title: Elimination Flag

costCenterCode.description: FK to AnalyticalDimension.code (dimensionType=cost-center) for dimension-tagged analytical reporting +. A business key, not an object identifier. Field name and stored values are unchanged; only the target was re-pointed from the retired CostCenter schema to the unified AnalyticalDimension, so this stays backwards-compatible with the existing costCenter field.
costCenterCode.title: Cost Center Code

costCarrierCode.description: FK to AnalyticalDimension.code (dimensionType=cost-object) for cost-unit analytical reporting +. A business key, not an object identifier. Field name and stored values are unchanged; only the target was re-pointed from the retired KostenDrager schema to the unified AnalyticalDimension.
costCarrierCode.title: Kosten Drager Code

projectCode.description: FK to Project.code for project accounting and WBSO time-per-project pre-positioning +.
projectCode.title: Project Code

dimensions.description: Free-form key-to-value map for custom analytical dimensions (AnalyticalDimension.dimensionType=custom). Each key MUST match an AnalyticalDimension.code where dimensionType=custom; each value MUST resolve to an existing record code in that register. Validation is declared via OR relations engine +.
dimensions.title: Dimensions

ozbCategory.description: OZB category flags enabling the Iv3-OZB aggregation to split OZB-postings by eigenaars/gebruikers-deel and woning/niet-woning. Null on non-OZB lines.
ozbCategory.title: OZB Category

consolidatedTrialBalance.description: Trial-balance rollup that excludes inter-GR lines flagged for elimination. Produces debit and credit totals per accountNumber for the GR own jaarrekening.

segmentPnlByCostCenter.description: Segment P&L roll-up keyed by costCenterCode and fiscalYearId. Aggregates debit and credit amounts per cost center, rolling child cost centers up to their parent via the AnalyticalDimension(dimensionType=cost-center) self-relation +. Consumed by launchpad widgets via runtime GraphQL. Re-targeted from CostCenter to AnalyticalDimension (field name and stored values unchanged).

segmentPnlByKostenDrager.description: Segment P&L roll-up keyed by kostenDragerCode and fiscalYearId. Mirrors the cost-center aggregation for the cost-object dimension +. Re-targeted from the retired KostenDrager register to AnalyticalDimension(dimensionType=cost-object). Field name and stored values unchanged.

segmentPnlByProject.description: Segment P&L roll-up keyed by projectCode and fiscalYearId. Used for project accounting and as the time-per-project projection target for WBSO pre-positioning +.

iv3DetailByTaakveldCategorie.description: Iv3-detail roll-up grouping GLLine records by (periodId, taakveld, categorie) summing (debit - credit). Joins GLLine → Account → BbvAccountMapping for taakveld + iv3Categorie. Sum across all categorieën per taakveld MUST equal the base IV3 total for that taakveld (€0 tolerance). Quarterly cadence; docudesk template: iv3-detail-2026.csv; openconnector source: cbs-iv3-detail.

netBedrag.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE -amount END)
netBedrag.description: Net bedrag (debit minus credit) in EUR for this taakveld-categorie combination.

iv3OzbByCategorieHeffing.description: Iv3-OZB roll-up grouping OZB-postings by (periodId, ozbCategorie). Filters to GLLine records where ozbCategorie is set. Produces separate totals per ozbCategorie value. CSV output per CBS Iv3-OZB layout; openconnector source: cbs-iv3-ozb.

netBedrag.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE -amount END)
netBedrag.description: Net OZB bedrag (debit minus credit) in EUR per ozbCategorie.

GRDeelnemer.title: GR Participant
GRDeelnemer.description: A deelnemer (participating municipality, province, or waterboard) of a gemeenschappelijke regeling (GR). Holds the quotum-aandeel and an optional cross-administration FK for doorbelasting materialisation.

administrationId.description: Optional FK to the deelnemer's own shillinq administration. When set, a balanced GLTransaction is materialised in that administration on GR period-close.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

share.description: Quotum-aandeel (participation share) of this deelnemer in the GR. Must be 0 ≤ x ≤ 1. The sum across all actief deelnemers SHOULD equal 1.0.
share.title: Share

actief.description: Whether this deelnemer currently participates in the GR. Inactive deelnemers are excluded from the aandeel-sum invariant check.
actief.title: Active

lifecycleState.description: Lifecycle state of the deelnemer record.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

active.label: Active
active.description: Deelnemer participates in the GR and is included in aandeel-sum and doorbelasting calculations.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Deelnemer no longer participates. Historical records remain queryable; excluded from aandeel-sum and doorbelasting calculations.

archive.label: Archive deelnemer
archive.description: Remove from active participation without deleting historical boekingen.

onGrPeriodClose.description: When the GR period closes, materialise a balanced GLTransaction in each deelnemer's administration where administrationId is set. Idempotency key: (grAdministrationId, deelnemerId, periodId) prevents re-posting on re-run of GR period-close.
onGrPeriodClose.condition: administrationId IS NOT NULL AND lifecycleState = 'active'

aandeelSumCheck.description: Computes the sum of aandeel across all actief deelnemers. Surfaces a non-blocking warning in the Consolidated view when the result differs from 1.0 and design Risk 2.

GRVerdeelsleutel.title: GR Allocation Key
GRVerdeelsleutel.description: An apportionment rule linking a cost-cluster (set of accountNumbers) to a per-deelnemer split method. Multiple verdeelsleutels MAY apply to the same cost cluster, sequenced by lineNumber.

keyName.description: Human-readable name of this apportionment rule.
keyName.title: Key Name

costClusterAccountNumbers.description: Array of Account.accountNumber strings identifying the cost cluster this verdeelsleutel applies to.
costClusterAccountNumbers.title: Cost Cluster Account Numbers

verdelingsType.description: Apportionment method. vast-percentage uses fixed per-deelnemer percentages in parameters; resident-count weights by population count; weighted-area by weighted surface area; custom-formula accepts free-form parameters JSON.
verdelingsType.title: Distribution Type

parameters.description: Per-deelnemer split parameters validated against verdelingsType. For vast-percentage: object keyed by GRDeelnemer.id with values summing to 1.0. For custom-formula: arbitrary JSON.
parameters.title: Parameters

lineNumber.description: Sequence number controlling the order in which multiple verdeelsleutels for the same cost cluster are applied.
lineNumber.title: Line Number

doorbelastingPerDeelnemer.description: Per-deelnemer doorbelasting aggregation: applies this verdeelsleutel to GLLines whose accountNumber is in costClusterAccountNumbers (excluding eliminated lines). Produces doorbelasting bedrag per deelnemer per cost cluster.

join.condition: GLLine.accountNumber IN costClusterAccountNumbers AND GLLine.eliminationFlag = false

Account.title: Account
Account.description: A hierarchical chart-of-accounts entry conforming to the RGS (Referentie Grootboek Schema) standard for Dutch bookkeeping.

accountNumber.description: RGS-style account code (e.g. '1000', '4100'). Unique within an administration.
accountNumber.title: Account Number

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code for this account's base currency.
currency.title: Currency

parentAccountNumber.description: FK to the parent Account.accountNumber for hierarchy navigation.
parentAccountNumber.title: Parent Account Number

isClosingAccount.description: Designates this as the administration's single closing account for period-end equity absorption.
isClosingAccount.title: Is Closing Account

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this account. Scopes uniqueness of accountNumber.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the account.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

description.description: Operator-authored free-text description of the account.
description.title: Description

vatApplicable.description: Whether VAT/BTW applies to transactions posted to this account.
vatApplicable.title: VAT Applicable

esaClassifier.description: ESA 2010 (European System of Accounts) sector classifier. Drives EMU-saldo computation's sector grouping. S.1311 = centrale overheid, S.1312 = deelstaatoverheid (N/A in NL), S.1313 = lokale overheid (gemeente/provincie/waterschap), S.1314 = wettelijke sociale verzekering. S.11–S.15/S.2 are non-government sectors per ESA 2010.
esaClassifier.title: Esa Classifier

bbvVariant.description: BBV regulatory variant under which this account is interpreted. 'waterAuthority' activates the BBVW (BBV-Waterschappen) framework.
bbvVariant.title: BBV Variant

vpbPligtig.description: Marks this account as Vpb-pligtig per Wet modernisering Vpb-plicht (2016). When true, postings against this account contribute to the Vpb-balans aggregation. Default false — only accounts explicitly tagged by the bookkeeper contribute.
vpbPligtig.title: VPB Liable

daysUntilRetention.description: Derived (do not set directly): always null for Account (kept indefinitely). Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
daysUntilRetention.title: Days Until Retention

emuAggregationHash.description: Derived (do not set directly): stable SHA-256 audit hash over the contributing-GLLine count + esaClassifier for the last EMU computation. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations from the emuContributors aggregate-ref.
emuAggregationHash.title: Emu Aggregation Hash

retention.description: Chart-of-accounts records are kept indefinitely per Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020 § 5.1.1 (begroting, jaarrekening, rekeningschema).

active.label: Active
active.description: Fully usable for new GL postings.

blocked.label: Blocked
blocked.description: Readable and referenceable by existing postings, but rejected as the target of new GL lines.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical only — no new postings, no edits; remains queryable.

block.label: Block account
block.description: Prevent new postings against this account.

unblock.label: Unblock account
unblock.description: Re-enable new postings against this account.

archiveFromActive.label: Archive account
archiveFromActive.description: Move to historical archive. Requires zero open balance.

archiveFromBlocked.label: Archive account
archiveFromBlocked.description: Move to historical archive from blocked state. Requires zero open balance.

emuSaldoByQuarter.description: Quarterly EMU-saldo (debit minus credit) grouped by ESA-2010 sector for a given quarter, riding the IV3-base quarterly data. Filters GLLine rows by period and respects per-line emuInclusionRule (included|partial only; excluded lines are omitted). Partial lines count at 50% contribution. If the declarative engine cannot express the combined multi-sector + emuInclusionRule filter, the guard OCA\Shillinq\Guard\EmuCalculator:computeQuarterlySaldo is invoked per ADR-031 exception path.

emuSaldoByYear.description: Annual EMU-saldo and EMU-schuld from the closed jaarrekening. Filters all closed-year GLLine rows, groups by ESA-2010 sector, and respects emuInclusionRule. EMU-schuld is derived as the cumulative net liability position across S.13 sectors. Same guard fallback as quarterly per ADR-031.

daysUntilRetention.description: Account records are kept indefinitely (disposition: keep_indefinite per selectielijst:5.1.1). This field always returns null for Account objects. JSON-AST: lit(null).

emuAggregationHash.description: Declarative (ADR-031) stable SHA-256 hash over the contributing-GLLine count + esaClassifier for this account's last EMU computation, enabling audit-trail reproducibility. The contributing set is folded via the emuContributors aggregate-ref (closed GLLines with emuInclusionRule in [included, partial], joined on accountNumber). Replaces the former imperative sha256(@aggregation.) string; the @params.emuInclusionRule term is dropped (not available in the calc payload) — same contributing set + sector still yields the same hash. JSON-AST: sha256(concat(@aggregate.emuContributors, ':', esaClassifier)).

RetentionRule.title: Retention period
RetentionRule.description: Archiefwet 1995 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020 retention rule. Declares the statutory retention obligation for a record category per Selectielijst code. Seeded from selectielijst-gemeenten-2020.json; operators MAY add administration-scoped overrides above the statutory minimum.

daysUntilRetention.description: Days until this retention rule expires (effectiveTo - today). Null when effectiveTo is absent. JSON-AST: if(effectiveTo != null, diffDays(effectiveTo, now), null).

nearing-retention.title: Bewaartermijnen verlopen binnenkort
nearing-retention.description: Count of records nearing retention disposition within THRESHOLD_DAYS (default 90). Surfaced on the Bewaartermijnen dashboard.

archivist.description: Full access to view, create, and override retention rules.

auditor.description: Read-only access for audit and compliance inspection.

description.description: Plain-Dutch description of the record category covered by this rule.
description.example: Dagelijkse financiële verantwoording (facturen, betalingen, dagboeken, bankafschriften)
description.title: Description

recordCategory.description: High-level category of records covered by this rule.
recordCategory.title: Record Category

retentionYears.description: Absolute retention period in years from record creation date. Mutually exclusive with retentionTrigger.
retentionYears.title: Retention Years

retentionTrigger.description: Relative retention expression (e.g. '10 years after vaststellingDate'). Mutually exclusive with retentionYears.
retentionTrigger.title: Retention Trigger

disposition.description: Action taken when the retention period expires.
disposition.title: Disposition

legalBasis.description: Citation of the legal basis: Archiefwet article + Selectielijst paragraph.
legalBasis.title: Legal Basis

effectiveFrom.description: Date from which this rule is valid.
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

effectiveTo.description: Date until which this rule is valid. Absent means the rule has no end date.
effectiveTo.title: Effective To

customRetentionYears.description: Operator-defined extension of the statutory retention period (archiefverordening override). MUST be >= retentionYears — operators may extend retention but NEVER shorten below the Archiefwet floor.

x-openregister-validation.message: customRetentionYears MUST be >= retentionYears. Operators may extend retention but not shorten it below the statutory minimum (Archiefwet 1995 + REQ-ARC-004).

customRetentionYears.title: Custom Retention Years

administrationId.description: Administration identifier for per-administration override rules (archiefverordening scope). Absent on seeded default rules which apply to all administrations.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

daysUntilRetention.description: Derived (do not set directly): days until this rule expires (effectiveTo - today); null when effectiveTo is absent. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
daysUntilRetention.title: Days Until Retention

source.description: Origin: 'seeded' for Selectielijst defaults, 'operator-edited' for administration-specific overrides.
source.title: Source

BalanceSheet.title: Balance Sheet
BalanceSheet.description: Financial statement showing assets, liabilities, and equity at a fiscal-period snapshot. Status lifecycle: draft → final → published. Totals are computed via x-openregister-aggregations from GL entries grouped by Account.accountType.

reportDate.description: Snapshot date of the balance sheet (typically fiscal-year-end).
reportDate.title: Report Date

totalAssets.description: Computed total assets in base currency. Populated by balance-sheet aggregation on draft→final transition.
totalAssets.title: Total Assets

totalLiabilities.description: Computed total liabilities in base currency. Populated by balance-sheet aggregation on draft→final transition.
totalLiabilities.title: Total Liabilities

totalEquity.description: Computed total equity in base currency. Populated by balance-sheet aggregation on draft→final transition.
totalEquity.title: Total Equity

isBalanced.description: Computed flag: totalAssets = totalLiabilities + totalEquity. Surfaced with diagnostic when false.
isBalanced.title: Is Balanced

currency.description: ISO 4217 base currency code.
currency.title: Currency

status.description: Lifecycle state of the balance sheet.
status.title: Status

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear this balance sheet covers.
fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal Year ID

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this balance sheet belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Balance sheet under preparation; GL entries may still be posted.

final.label: Final
final.description: GL period closed; all entries posted; aggregations computed and verified.

published.label: Published
published.description: Released to stakeholders via OR publication extension. Immutable — no further edits.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Retained for audit trail per administration retention policy.

finalise.label: Finalise balance sheet
finalise.description: Operator or scheduled workflow closes fiscal period. Triggers balance-sheet aggregation.

publish.label: Publish balance sheet
publish.description: Operator (role: controller) releases to stakeholders via OR publication extension or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031.

archive.label: Archive balance sheet
archive.description: Operator archives after retention period per administration retention policy.

onFinalise.description: Fire balance-sheet aggregation to populate totalAssets, totalLiabilities, totalEquity, and isBalanced from GL entries. Also triggers TrialBalance finalisation for the same fiscalYearId and administrationId.

onPublish.description: Publication workflow via OR publication extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031. Records publication timestamp and actor. Marks statement immutable.

balanceSheetTotals.description: Computes totalAssets, totalLiabilities, totalEquity from GLLine entries grouped by Account.accountType for the fiscal period. Satisfies. No BalanceSheetService — pure declarative aggregation per ADR-031.

isBalanced.diagnostic: Balance-sheet equation violated: assets({{totalAssets}}) ≠ liabilities({{totalLiabilities}}) + equity({{totalEquity}})

TrialBalance.title: Trial Balance
TrialBalance.description: Listing of all GL accounts with debit/credit balances for period verification. isBalanced flag (totalDebits = totalCredits) computed via aggregation. No TrialBalanceService.

reportDate.description: Snapshot date of the trial balance (typically fiscal-year-end).
reportDate.title: Report Date

totalDebits.description: Sum of all debit balances across all accounts for the fiscal period.
totalDebits.title: Total Debits

totalCredits.description: Sum of all credit balances across all accounts for the fiscal period.
totalCredits.title: Total Credits

isBalanced.description: Computed flag: totalDebits = totalCredits. Surfaced with diagnostic when false.

status.description: Lifecycle state of the trial balance.

preparedBy.description: Actor who prepared or verified the trial balance (audit trail).
preparedBy.title: Prepared By

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear this trial balance covers.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration this trial balance belongs to.

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Trial balance under preparation; GL entries may still be posted.

verified.label: Verified

final.label: Final
final.description: GL period closed; all entries posted; trial balance verified and locked.

published.label: Published
published.description: Released to stakeholders via OR publication extension. Immutable.

archived.label: Archived

verify.label: Run trial-balance verification

finalise.label: Finalise trial balance
finalise.description: Operator or scheduled workflow closes fiscal period. Also triggered by BalanceSheet finalise hook.

publish.label: Publish trial balance

archive.label: Archive trial balance

onVerify.description: Fire trial-balance aggregation to populate totalDebits, totalCredits, and isBalanced. Surfaces diagnostic when not balanced.

onPublish.description: Publication workflow via OR publication extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031. Records publication timestamp and actor. Marks statement immutable.

trialBalanceTotals.description: Computes totalDebits, totalCredits, and isBalanced flag from GLLine entries for the fiscal period. Satisfies verification check. No TrialBalanceService — pure declarative aggregation per ADR-031.

trialBalanceByAccount.description: Per-account trial balance listing: accountNumber, name, accountType, totalDebits, totalCredits for the fiscal period.

ConsolidationGroup.title: Consolidation Group
ConsolidationGroup.description: A group of organizations consolidated together for financial reporting across multiple administrations. Holds the consolidation method (full/proportional/equity per IFRS 10/11/12) and inter-company elimination rules. Consumed by ConsolidatedReport.

name.description: Human-readable name of the consolidation group.
name.title: Name

status.description: Status of the consolidation group.
status.title: Status

parentOrganizationId.description: FK to the parent organization if part of a larger group.
parentOrganizationId.title: Parent Organization ID

eliminationRules.description: Inter-company elimination rules. Simple patterns (offset-by-FK, percentage-based) are declarative; complex custom rules defined by admin. Consumed by OR consolidation engine or ConsolidationGuard per ADR-031 exception.

intercompanySales.description: Eliminate inter-company sales between group members

eliminationRules.title: Elimination Rules

administrationIds.description: FKs to Administration records being consolidated into this group.
administrationIds.title: Administration Ids

active.label: Active
active.description: Consolidation group is in use for consolidated reporting.

inactive.label: Inactive
inactive.description: Consolidation group temporarily suspended; no new consolidated reports.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Historical group; remains queryable but no new consolidated reports.

reactivate.label: Reactivate group
reactivate.description: Restore consolidation group to active use.

archive.label: Archive group
archive.description: Archive consolidation group for historical reference.

ConsolidatedReport.title: Consolidated Report
ConsolidatedReport.description: Aggregated financial report combining data from multiple administrations with consolidation method and inter-company elimination tracking. Lifecycle draft → final → published consumes OR publication extension or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031.

reportNumber.description: Unique identifier for the consolidated report.
reportNumber.title: Report Number

consolidationGroupId.description: FK to the ConsolidationGroup defining which organizations are consolidated.
consolidationGroupId.title: Consolidation Group ID

consolidationMethod.description: Method used for this consolidated report (full/proportional/equity per IFRS 10/11/12).
consolidationMethod.title: Consolidation Method

eliminationsApplied.description: Whether inter-company eliminations have been posted for this report.
eliminationsApplied.title: Eliminations Applied

status.description: Lifecycle state of the consolidated report.
status.title: Status

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear this consolidated report covers.
fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal Year ID

draft.label: Draft
draft.description: Consolidated report under preparation. Individual administration statements may still be in draft.

final.label: Final
final.description: All member administrations finalised; consolidation and eliminations applied; report locked.

published.label: Published
published.description: Released to stakeholders via OR publication extension. Immutable.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Retained for audit trail per group retention policy.

finalise.label: Finalise consolidated report
finalise.description: Applies consolidation workflow and inter-company eliminations per ConsolidationGroup.eliminationRules. Consumed via OR consolidation extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031 exception.

publish.label: Publish consolidated report
publish.description: Operator (role: controller) releases to stakeholders via OR publication extension or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031.

archive.label: Archive consolidated report
archive.description: Operator archives after retention period per group retention policy.

onFinalise.description: Executes consolidation workflow via OR consolidation extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard. Sets eliminationsApplied=true after inter-company eliminations. Records audit trail of elimination amounts.

onPublish.description: Publication workflow via OR publication extension (ADR-022) or ConsolidationGuard fallback per ADR-031. Records publication timestamp and actor. Marks statement immutable.

Iv3Export.title: IV3 Export
Iv3Export.description: Quarterly IV3 (Informatie voor Derden) export to CBS for Dutch decentralised government administrations. Lifecycle covers generation, validation, submission, and CBS acceptance/rejection.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration (gemeente/provincie/waterschap) that this export belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

reportingYear.description: Calendar year of the IV3 reporting period (e.g. 2026).
reportingYear.title: Reporting Year

iv3Version.description: CBS IV3-bestand specification version used for this export (e.g. '2026.1').
iv3Version.title: Iv3Version

buckets.description: Aggregated GL values keyed by IV3 bucket code (sum of debit minus credit per bucket for closed-period postings). Derived via x-openregister-aggregations — do not set directly.
buckets.title: Buckets

xmlAttachmentUri.description: Docudesk URI of the generated CBS IV3 XML file.
xmlAttachmentUri.title: XML Attachment URI

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the IV3 export.
state.title: State

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when the export was generated.
generatedAt.title: Generated At

submittedAt.description: Timestamp when the export was submitted to CBS.
submittedAt.title: Submitted At

acceptedAt.description: Timestamp when CBS accepted the export.
acceptedAt.title: Accepted At

cbsMessageId.description: CBS-side message identifier returned on submission.
cbsMessageId.title: CBS Message ID

correctionOf.description: FK to a prior Iv3Export.id that this export supersedes (correction flow).
correctionOf.title: Correction Of

generated.label: Generated
generated.description: Export created and XML artifact generated. Awaiting operator validation.

validated.label: Validated
validated.description: XML validated against the CBS IV3 schema. Ready for operator submission.

submitted.label: Submitted
submitted.description: Submitted to CBS via OpenConnector cbs-iv3. Awaiting CBS acknowledgement.

accepted.label: Accepted
accepted.description: CBS accepted the export. Terminal state unless a correction is filed.

rejected.label: Rejected
rejected.description: CBS rejected the export. Operator must correct and re-validate.

corrected.label: Corrected
corrected.description: A correction export (with correctionOf set) supersedes this one.

retention.description: IV3 verantwoording-naar-derden records retained 10 years per Archiefwet 1995 + Selectielijst Gemeenten 2020.

validate.label: Validate XML
validate.description: Operator validates the generated XML against the CBS IV3 schema.

submit.label: Submit to CBS
submit.description: Operator submits the validated export to CBS via OpenConnector cbs-iv3.

accept.label: CBS Accepted
accept.description: CBS accepted the export (triggered by OpenConnector cbs-iv3 callback).

reject.label: CBS Rejected
reject.description: CBS rejected the export (triggered by OpenConnector cbs-iv3 callback).

revalidate.label: Re-validate after fix
revalidate.description: Operator re-validates after correcting the rejection reason.

correct.label: File correction
correct.description: Operator files a corrected export (sets correctionOf on the new Iv3Export).

buckets.description: Sum of (debit - credit) per IV3 bucket code over closed-period GLLine rows for this export's administrationId + quarter. Joins GLLine → Account → BbvAccountMapping.iv3Bucket (T3 bbv-compliance). Filters to periodIds closed per T2 period-close boundaries.

emuBestandSaldo.description: EMU-bestand aggregation consuming the ESA-2010 classifier declared in bookkeeping-emu-reporting and the EMU-bijlage inclusion/exclusion rules. The reported EMU-saldo MUST equal the EMU-reporting saldo to the cent (€0 tolerance). XML output per CBS EMU layout; openconnector source: cbs-emu-bestand.

emuSaldo.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN side = 'debit' THEN amount ELSE -amount END)
emuSaldo.description: EMU-saldo per ESA-2010 code in EUR. Aggregate equals total EMU-saldo for the period.

quarterly-cbs-submission.name: IV3 quarterly CBS submission
quarterly-cbs-submission.description: Generates and submits IV3 exports for all closed gemeente/provincie/waterschap administrations on a quarterly schedule.

kernGegevensConfig.title: Core Data Configuration
kernGegevensConfig.description: Administration-level configuration record holding the denominators required for the CBS Kerngegevens jaarstaten computation. Operators set these values yearly; the aggregation surfaces a 'denominator last updated' warning when any value is >12 months old.

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration (gemeente/provincie/waterschap) that this config belongs to.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

fiscalYearId.description: FK to the FiscalYear for which these denominators apply.
fiscalYearId.title: Fiscal Year ID

residentCount.description: Number of inhabitants per CBS Kerngegevens denominator. Used to compute lasten per inwoner, baten per inwoner, etc.
residentCount.title: Resident Count

area.description: Total surface area of the administration in km². Used for oppervlak-based denominators.
area.title: Area

weightedArea.description: Weighted surface area in km² (land + water weighted factor). Used for gewogen-oppervlak denominators.
weightedArea.title: Weighted Area

boardSize.description: Number of elected council seats (raadsleden / statenleden). Used for bestuursomvang-based ratios.
boardSize.title: Governing Board Size

civilServantsCount.description: FTE count of civil servants. Used for personeelslasten per fte denominator.
civilServantsCount.title: Number of Civil Servants

lastUpdatedAt.description: Date the operator last updated these denominators. Aggregation surfaces a warning when >12 months old.
lastUpdatedAt.title: Last Updated At

denominatorStaleWarning.description: Derived (do not set directly): true when denominators have not been updated in the past 12 months. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
denominatorStaleWarning.title: Denominator Stale Warning

denominatorStaleWarning.description: True when denominators have not been updated in the past 12 months. JSON-AST: if(lastUpdatedAt != null, diffDays(now, lastUpdatedAt) > 365, true).

kerngegevensRatios.description: Kerngegevens jaarstaten aggregation consuming the closed fiscal-year jaarrekening and the administration-level kernGegevensConfig denominators. Produces lasten per inwoner, baten per inwoner. Annual cadence; XML output; openconnector source: cbs-kerngegevens.

totalLasten.description: Total lasten (expenditure) for the fiscal year.

totalBaten.description: Total baten (revenue) for the fiscal year.

lastenPerInwoner.description: Lasten per inwoner ratio in EUR.

batenPerInwoner.description: Baten per inwoner ratio in EUR.

quarterly-cbs-iv3-detail-submission.name: Quarterly CBS Iv3-detail submission
quarterly-cbs-iv3-detail-submission.description: Generates and submits the Iv3-detail bestand for all closed administrations on a quarterly schedule. Triggers the iv3DetailByTaakveldCategorie aggregation on GLLine, renders via docudesk template iv3-detail-2026.csv, and submits via openconnector source cbs-iv3-detail.

quarterly-cbs-iv3-ozb-submission.name: Quarterly CBS Iv3-OZB submission
quarterly-cbs-iv3-ozb-submission.description: Generates and submits the Iv3-OZB bestand for all closed administrations on a periodic schedule. Triggers the iv3OzbByCategorieHeffing aggregation on GLLine, renders via docudesk template iv3-ozb-2026.csv, and submits via openconnector source cbs-iv3-ozb.

annual-cbs-kerngegevens-submission.name: Annual CBS Kerngegevens jaarstaten submission
annual-cbs-kerngegevens-submission.description: Generates and submits the Kerngegevens jaarstaten bestand annually after jaarrekening-close. Triggers the kerngegevensRatios aggregation, renders via docudesk template kerngegevens-2026.xml, and submits via openconnector source cbs-kerngegevens.

trigger.description: Annual trigger fires on jaarrekening-close lifecycle event from T3 bookkeeping-financial-statements per design D5.

annual-cbs-emu-bestand-submission.name: Annual CBS EMU-bestand submission
annual-cbs-emu-bestand-submission.description: Generates and submits the EMU-bestand annually and quarterly. Consumes the emuBestandSaldo aggregation on Iv3Export, renders via docudesk template emu-bestand-2026.xml, and submits via openconnector source cbs-emu-bestand.

trigger.description: Annual trigger fires on jaarrekening-close lifecycle event from T3. Quarterly runs are also triggered by the base IV3 quarterly workflow.

x-openregister-audit-trail.description: Every create, update and delete of a Core Data Configuration is written to OpenRegister's immutable audit trail with actor and timestamp.

BBVProgramma.title: BBV Programme
BBVProgramma.description: A BBV programma-indeling entry grouping GL postings by taakveld (gemeente/provincie) or kostentoedeling (waterschap). The programmaStructure discriminator controls which classification hierarchy is used.

code.description: Unique programma code within the administration (e.g. 'watersysteembeheer', 'taakveld-0.1').
code.title: Code

description.description: Optional operator-authored description of this programma.
description.example: Beheer van het watersysteem inclusief veiligheid en kwaliteit.
description.title: Description

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration owning this programma. Scopes uniqueness of code.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

programmeStructure.description: Discriminator that controls the classification hierarchy used at aggregation / rollup time. 'kostentoedeling' is the BBVW-canonical structure for waterschappen.
programmeStructure.title: Programme Structure

bbvVariant.description: BBV regulatory variant under which this programma is interpreted.
bbvVariant.title: BBV Variant

parentCode.description: FK to the parent BBVProgramma.code for hierarchical programma navigation.
parentCode.title: Parent Code

postingsByProgramma.description: Aggregates GL debit/credit totals per programma code, honouring the programmaStructure discriminator. When programmaStructure is 'kostentoedeling', groups by kostentoedeling cluster; when 'taskField', groups by taakveld code.

WaterschapHeffingPosting.title: Water Authority Levy Posting
WaterschapHeffingPosting.description: Sector-specific belasting posting for the three waterschapsbelastingen: watersysteemheffing, zuiveringsheffing, and verontreinigingsheffing. On transition to 'posted', materialises a balanced 2-line GLTransaction per T1 with sourceReference back to this posting. Does NOT carry its own ledger lines per design D3.

rateBasis.description: Canonical grondslag for the tarief computation (e.g. 'vervuilingseenheden', 'oppervlakte-m2', 'inwonerequivalenten').
rateBasis.title: Rate Basis

rate.description: Applied tarief per grondslag-eenheid in EUR.
rate.title: Rate

assessmentAmount.description: Total aanslag amount in EUR (tarief × grondslag-quantity). This amount is materialised into a balanced GLTransaction on post.
assessmentAmount.title: Assessment Amount

journalEntryId.description: FK to the materialised GLTransaction.id. Set by the lifecycle engine on transition to 'posted'. Null until posted.
journalEntryId.title: Journal Entry ID

emuExclusionRule.description: Controls whether this posting contributes to the waterschap EMU-saldo and the EMU-bijlage waterschappen handleiding 2026. 'excluded' = posting is omitted from the EMU-saldo aggregation; 'partial' = operator-defined partial inclusion.
emuExclusionRule.title: Emu Exclusion Rule

administrationId.description: FK to the waterschap Administration owning this heffing posting.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

debitAccountNumber.description: Account to debit in the materialised GLTransaction (e.g. receivable account for the heffing aanslag).
debitAccountNumber.title: Debit Account Number

creditAccountNumber.description: Account to credit in the materialised GLTransaction (e.g. revenue account for the heffing type).
creditAccountNumber.title: Credit Account Number

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the heffing posting.
state.title: State

description.description: Optional operator-authored description or reference number.
description.title: Description

draft.label: Concept
draft.description: Heffing posting is being prepared; no GL impact yet.

posted.label: Geboekt
posted.description: Posting is confirmed; a balanced 2-line GLTransaction has been materialised.

reversed.label: Gestorneerd
reversed.description: Posting has been reversed; a contra-GLTransaction has been materialised.

post.label: Boek aanslag
post.description: Materialise a balanced 2-line GLTransaction (debit receivable, credit revenue) for the aanslagBedrag and set journalEntryId.

reverse.label: Storneer aanslag
reverse.description: Materialise a contra-GLTransaction to reverse the original posting.

onPost.description: Materialise a balanced 2-line GLTransaction per T1. Debit debitAccountNumber for aanslagBedrag, credit creditAccountNumber for aanslagBedrag. Set sourceReference to WaterschapHeffingPosting.id. Write journalEntryId FK back to this record. Idempotency key: (administrationId, id) prevents re-posting on repair-step re-run.

totalByHeffingType.description: Total aanslag bedrag per heffingType for the administration, excluding reversed postings. Used by the waterschapsbelastingen index page.

emuIncludedTotal.description: Total aanslag bedrag for postings included in the EMU-saldo computation (emuExclusionRule != 'excluded'). Read by the bookkeeping-emu-reporting sibling spec.

FixedAsset.title: Fixed Asset
FixedAsset.description: A capitalised tangible or intangible business asset with declarative depreciation rules, parallel commercial/fiscal streams, and a managed lifecycle (proposed → active → disposed → archived). Depreciation values are derived on demand — no materialised schedule table.

assetNumber.description: Operator-assigned unique reference within the administration (e.g. FA-0001).
assetNumber.title: Asset Number

name.description: Human-readable asset name (e.g. Dell laptop XPS-15).
name.title: Name

acquisitionCost.description: Original cost in the administration's base currency.
acquisitionCost.title: Acquisition Cost

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the acquisition cost.
currency.title: Currency

residualValue.description: Estimated salvage value at end of useful life.
residualValue.title: Residual Value

depreciationMethod.description: Depreciation method applied to this asset.
depreciationMethod.title: Depreciation Method

degressiveRate.description: Annual declining-balance percentage when depreciationMethod = degressive (e.g. 0.20 for 20%). Required when method is degressive.
degressiveRate.title: Degressive Rate

commercialRate.description: Annual depreciation rate for commercial books (IFRS / Dutch GAAP). When set together with fiscalRate, two parallel streams are produced.
commercialRate.title: Commercial Rate

fiscalRate.description: Annual depreciation rate for fiscal books (Wet IB / Wet VPB). May differ from commercialRate (e.g. Wet IB 20% cap rule).
fiscalRate.title: Fiscal Rate

assetAccountNumber.description: FK to the Account carrying the asset's gross value (e.g. 0220).
assetAccountNumber.title: Asset Account Number

accumulatedDepAccountNumber.description: FK to the contra Account for accumulated depreciation (e.g. 0225).
accumulatedDepAccountNumber.title: Accumulated Dep Account Number

depreciationExpenseAccountNumber.description: FK to the P&L Account for the depreciation expense charge (e.g. 4500).
depreciationExpenseAccountNumber.title: Depreciation Expense Account Number

disposalDate.description: Date the asset was disposed of (sale, scrap, donation). Set when lifecycleState transitions to disposed.
disposalDate.title: Disposal Date

disposalAccountingTreatment.description: Accounting treatment on disposal. Required when disposalDate is set.
disposalAccountingTreatment.title: Disposal Accounting Treatment

monthlyDepreciation.description: Derived (do not set directly): monthly depreciation charge for the current period. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
monthlyDepreciation.title: Monthly Depreciation

currentBookValue.description: Derived (do not set directly): current net book value. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
currentBookValue.title: Current Book Value

commercialBookValue.description: Derived (do not set directly): net book value under the commercial depreciation stream. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
commercialBookValue.title: Commercial Book Value

fiscalBookValue.description: Derived (do not set directly): net book value under the fiscal depreciation stream. Materialised via x-openregister-calculations.
fiscalBookValue.title: Fiscal Book Value

lifecycleState.description: Current lifecycle state of the asset.
lifecycleState.title: Lifecycle State

administrationId.description: Reference to the Administration owning this asset. Scopes uniqueness of assetNumber.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

monthlyDepreciation.description: Monthly depreciation charge for the current period. Zero for none-method; linear straight-line; degressive uses currentBookValue. JSON-AST nested if over depreciationMethod.

currentBookValue.description: Current net book value: acquisitionCost minus accumulated linear depreciation from acquisitionDate to today, floored at residualValue. none-method equals acquisitionCost. JSON-AST uses max + monthsElapsed.

commercialBookValue.description: Net book value under the commercial depreciation stream (IFRS / Dutch GAAP). Falls back to currentBookValue when commercialRate is null. JSON-AST uses max + monthsElapsed.

fiscalBookValue.description: Net book value under the fiscal depreciation stream (Wet IB / Wet VPB). Falls back to currentBookValue when fiscalRate is null. JSON-AST uses max + monthsElapsed.

proposed.label: Proposed
proposed.description: Asset is under consideration for capitalisation. Not yet active on the balance sheet.

active.label: Active
active.description: Asset is capitalised and subject to periodic depreciation postings.

disposed.label: Disposed
disposed.description: Asset has been sold, scrapped, donated, or transferred. A closing JournalEntry has been emitted.

archived.label: Archived
archived.description: Asset record is retained for historical reference only. No further postings or edits.

activate.label: Activate asset
activate.description: Capitalise the asset and start the depreciation clock.

dispose.label: Dispose asset
dispose.description: Dispose of the asset and emit a closing JournalEntry (credits asset account for gross value, debits accumulated depreciation, posts gain/loss based on disposalAccountingTreatment and disposal proceeds).

action.description: Emits a balanced JournalEntry zeroing the asset account and accumulated depreciation, and posting any gain or loss to the configured P&L account based on disposalAccountingTreatment.

archive.label: Archive asset
archive.description: Move disposed asset to historical archive.

rejectProposal.label: Reject proposal
rejectProposal.description: Reject the asset proposal without capitalising it.

totalByCategory.description: Number of active assets per assetCategory.

totalAcquisitionCost.description: Total gross acquisition cost of all active assets.

KorThreshold.title: KOR Threshold
KorThreshold.description: Versioned statutory KOR threshold record per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 1. Seeded from kor-thresholds-2026.json; multiple records with non-overlapping effectiveFrom/effectiveTo windows support future statutory revisions.

thresholdAmount.description: Statutory KOR omzetdrempel in EUR (currently €20,000 per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 1).
thresholdAmount.title: Threshold Amount

warningPercentage.description: Percentage of thresholdAmount at which the threshold-warning notification fires (default 80).
warningPercentage.title: Warning Percentage

fiscalYear.description: Fiscal year this threshold record applies to.
fiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year

citation.description: Statutory citation for this threshold value.
citation.title: Citation

effectiveFrom.description: Date from which this threshold record is effective.
effectiveFrom.title: Effective From

effectiveTo.description: Date after which this threshold is superseded. Null means currently in force.
effectiveTo.title: Effective To

KorRegime.title: KOR Regime
KorRegime.description: KOR (Kleine Ondernemersregeling) opt-in/opt-out regime record per administrationId and calendar year. Tracks the 5-state lifecycle, YTD revenue (declarative calculation over Invoice T2), threshold, and generates a pending JournalEntry on opt-out. Visibility restricted to mkb/zzp administration types.

administrationId.description: FK to the administration owning this KOR regime record.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

state.description: Current KOR lifecycle state.
state.title: State

currentCalendarYear.description: Calendar year tracked by ytdRevenue. KOR applies per calendar year (Wet OB 1968 art. 25).
currentCalendarYear.title: Current Calendar Year

ytdRevenue.description: Year-to-date revenue within currentCalendarYear, derived via x-openregister-calculations from Invoice (T2 AR sub-ledger). Do not set directly.
ytdRevenue.title: Ytd Revenue

thresholdAmount.description: Active KOR omzetdrempel for currentCalendarYear; read from KorThreshold seed. Default €20,000.
thresholdAmount.title: Threshold Amount

warningPercentage.description: Warning fires at warningPercentage % of thresholdAmount; read from KorThreshold seed. Default 80.
warningPercentage.title: Warning Percentage

exceededAt.description: Date when ytdRevenue first crossed the full threshold.
exceededAt.title: Exceeded At

notes.description: Operator-authored context (e.g. 'Opt-out due to ICP-omzet uitsluiting').
notes.title: Notes

retention.description: KOR financial records retained 7 years per AWR art. 52 (financiële administratie bewaarplicht).

outside.label: Buiten KOR
outside.description: Administration is not enrolled in KOR. No BTW exemption on outputs.

opted-in.label: KOR actief
opted-in.description: Administration is enrolled in KOR. BTW-vrijstelling op outputs geldt.

threshold-warning.label: Drempelwaarschuwing (80%)
threshold-warning.description: YTD revenue has reached 80% of the omzetdrempel. Operator should monitor closely.

threshold-exceeded.label: Drempel overschreden (100%)
threshold-exceeded.description: YTD revenue has reached or exceeded the omzetdrempel. Opt-out required.

opted-out.label: Buiten KOR (opt-out)
opted-out.description: Administration has opted out of KOR. 3-year re-entry lock-out applies per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 3.

optIn.label: Opt in bij KOR
optIn.description: Operator opts the administration into KOR for the current calendar year. Belastingdienst notification is the operator's responsibility.

warnThreshold.label: Drempelwaarschuwing
warnThreshold.description: Auto-transitions when ytdRevenue reaches warningPercentage % of thresholdAmount (default 80% = €16,000 on €20,000 threshold). Calculation-crossing trigger per ADR-031.

exceedThreshold.label: Drempel overschreden
exceedThreshold.description: Auto-transitions when ytdRevenue reaches or exceeds thresholdAmount. Calculation-crossing trigger per ADR-031.

yearRollover.label: Jaar-rollover
yearRollover.description: Reverts threshold-warning to opted-in on Jan 1 when ytdRevenue resets to zero for the new calendar year.

optOutFromExceeded.label: Opt out (drempel)
optOutFromExceeded.description: Administration opts out following threshold exceedance. Generates a pending JournalEntry for regime-change BTW reclamation reversal.

returnToOutside.label: Terug buiten KOR
returnToOutside.description: After the 3-year re-entry lock-out per Wet OB 1968 art. 25 lid 3, operator may return to outside state.

onOptOut.description: On threshold-exceeded → opted-out: create a JournalEntry template for BTW reclamation reversal. MUST ship in state: pending safety constraint. Operator + accountant approval required before posting.

data.description: KOR-regimewijziging: terugdraaien vrijgestelde BTW op outputs (art. 15 lid 2 Wet OB 1968). Goedkeuring vereist van operator en accountant alvorens boeking.

ytdRevenue.description: Year-to-date revenue sum from Invoice (T2 AR sub-ledger) for this administrationId within currentCalendarYear. Excludes cancelled invoices and credit notes. Cross-object SUM relocated from x-openregister-calculations per ADR-031 (the per-object evaluator cannot fold over other objects). Per; ADR-031 exception path: if OR's aggregation engine cannot express the period filter, a thin single-method KorThresholdGuard:currentYtdRevenue guard (~30 LOC) is permitted.

FiscalYear.title: Fiscal Year
FiscalYear.description: Fiscal year lifecycle record tracking the open -> closing -> closed -> reopened state machine for year-end close through. The open -> closing transition emits a balanced retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry (manual sub-type). The closing -> closed transition emits an opening-balance JournalEntry for the next year (balance-sheet accounts only) and fires CloudEvents for dimensional rollover. The admin-only closed -> reopened transition emits two reversing JournalEntry records pairing with the original journals for full audit traceability. No YearEndCloseService PHP class; all close logic is schema-declared per ADR-031.

yearNumber.description: Calendar year reference (e.g. 2026). MUST be unique per administrationId.
yearNumber.title: Year Number

startDate.description: First day of the fiscal year. Typically YYYY-01-01 but supports broken fiscal years.
startDate.title: Start Date

endDate.description: Last day of the fiscal year.
endDate.title: End Date

state.description: Current lifecycle state of the fiscal year.
state.title: State

closingJournalId.description: FK to the JournalEntry that posted the year-end retained-earnings transfer (set by open -> closing action per).
closingJournalId.title: Closing Journal ID

openingJournalId.description: FK to the JournalEntry that posted the next-year opening balances (set by closing -> closed action per).
openingJournalId.title: Opening Journal ID

closedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the close completed. Required when state = closed.
closedAt.title: Closed At

closedBy.description: NC user id of the actor who completed the close. Required when state = closed.
closedBy.title: Closed By

reopenedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when the year was reopened. Required when state = reopened.
reopenedAt.title: Reopened At

reopenedBy.description: NC user id of the admin who reopened the fiscal year. Required when state = reopened.
reopenedBy.title: Reopened By

reopenReason.description: Operator-supplied justification for the reopen. Required (non-empty) when initiating the closed -> reopened transition.
reopenReason.example: Correction of retained-earnings posting following 2026 audit finding
reopenReason.title: Reopen Reason

administrationId.description: FK to the Administration that owns this fiscal year. Combined with yearNumber forms the composite uniqueness key per D5.
administrationId.title: Administration ID

open.label: Open
open.description: Fiscal year is active; GL transactions post normally to this period.

closing.label: Closing
closing.description: Year-end close is in progress (semantically the spec's in-progress state per); retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry posted. GL still writable until the closed transition completes. The closing checklist is being evaluated.

closed.label: Closed
closed.description: Fiscal year is closed. Opening-balance JournalEntry posted for the next year. Dimensional rollover CloudEvents fired. GL becomes immutable for this period (archive-period locking via immutablePeriod flag).

immutablePeriod.description: Per: once a FiscalYear enters the closed state, all GLTransaction and GLLine records whose periodId / postingDate resolves to this fiscal year become read-only. New transactions are rejected with NC error 'Fiscal Year @self.yearNumber is closed and immutable. To post corrections, unclose the period (reopen), post the entry, and re-close.' Reads remain unrestricted for audit and reporting.

reopened.label: Reopened
reopened.description: Admin-initiated escape hatch. Two reversing JournalEntry records pair with the original closing and opening journals. GL is writable again.

beginClose.label: Begin year-end close
beginClose.description: Starts the year-end close. Requires all T3 fiscal periods within this year to be in state closed. Emits a balanced retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry (manual sub-type): credits revenue account closing balances to the closing account (isClosingAccount: true per REQ-CoA-009), debits expense account closing balances, posts net result to the retained-earnings equity account.

close.label: Complete year-end close
close.description: Completes the year-end close. Emits an opening-balance JournalEntry for the next FiscalYear (balance-sheet accounts only; P&L accounts excluded per). Auto-creates next FiscalYear record in state open if absent. Fires CloudEvents per dimension register (AnalyticalDimension, Project) for dimensional rollover; each subscriber carries active dimensions forward and skips archived. Re-targeted from the retired CostCenter + KostenDrager to the unified AnalyticalDimension. The transition is gated by the closing checklist declared in `requirePreconditions`; CFO override via `overrideChecklist: true` is audit-trailed.

requirePreconditions.label: Trial Balance Verified
requirePreconditions.description: Item 1: sum(debit GL lines) = sum(credit GL lines) for the FY within rounding tolerance.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Trial Balance Verified: FAIL — imbalance @value cents. Post the correcting entry and try again.

requirePreconditions.label: Accruals Recorded
requirePreconditions.description: Item 2: when accrual accounts (default range 9700-9799) carry a non-zero balance, at least one ClosingEntry with entryType in {accrual-reversal, manual} (or a JournalEntry with subType year-end-closing) MUST be posted for this FY.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Accruals Recorded: FAIL — accrual accounts carry a non-zero balance but no accrual-reversal closing entry has been posted.

requirePreconditions.label: Depreciation Posted
requirePreconditions.description: Item 3: when active FixedAsset records exist for this administration, a ClosingEntry of entryType depreciation MUST be posted for the FY. From T4-base bookkeeping-fixed-assets-depreciation.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Depreciation Posted: FAIL — active fixed assets exist but no depreciation closing entry has been posted.

requirePreconditions.label: FX Gains/Losses Declared
requirePreconditions.description: Item 4: when the administration's currency configuration includes a non-base currency, each foreign-currency GL account MUST have an FX revaluation closing entry. Multi-currency revaluation is the T5 boundary; T4 enforces declaration only.
requirePreconditions.failMessage: FX Gains/Losses Declared: FAIL — foreign-currency accounts exist but no FX revaluation closing entry has been declared.

requirePreconditions.label: Related-Party Transactions Reviewed
requirePreconditions.description: Item 5: when any GLTransaction or JournalEntry carries `relatedParty: true`, the financial officer MUST acknowledge them via `GLTransaction.relatedPartyAcknowledged: true` (or the equivalent on JournalEntry).
requirePreconditions.failMessage: Related-Party Transactions Reviewed: FAIL — @value related-party transactions remain unacknowledged.

reopen.label: Reopen fiscal year
reopen.description: Admin-only escape hatch. Emits two JournalEntry records of sub-type reversing pairing with closingJournalId and openingJournalId respectively. Recorded as a CloudEvent in the admin notifications stream. Non-empty reopenReason required.

onBeginClose.description: Emit retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry on open -> closing. OR engine sums revenue account closing balances (credit to closing account) and expense account closing balances (debit from closing account); net result posted to retained-earnings equity account.

data.description: Year-end retained-earnings transfer — boekjaar @self.yearNumber. Omzet- en kostenrekeningen afgesloten naar sluitrekening; nettoresultaat geboekt op eigen-vermogenrekening.

onClose.description: Emit opening-balance JournalEntry for the next fiscal year on closing -> closed. Balance-sheet accounts only (assets, liabilities, equity); P&L accounts excluded. Auto-create next FiscalYear in state open if absent.

data.description: Openingsbalans boekjaar @self.yearNumber + 1. Balansrekeningen overgenomen uit afsluiting boekjaar @self.yearNumber; resultaatrekeningen op nul.

onCloseDimensionRollover.description: Fire CloudEvents for dimensional rollover on closing -> closed. AnalyticalDimension (all dimensionTypes: cost-center, cost-object, custom) and Project subscribers carry active dimensions forward; archived dimensions skipped. Re-targeted from the retired CostCenter + KostenDrager registers to the unified AnalyticalDimension.

onReopenReverseClosing.description: Emit reversing JournalEntry for the retained-earnings transfer journal (closingJournalId) on closed -> reopened.

onReopenReverseOpening.description: Emit reversing JournalEntry for the opening-balance journal (openingJournalId) on closed -> reopened.

onReopenNotify.description: Record the reopen as a CloudEvent in the admin notifications stream.

onBeginCloseGenerateClosingEntries.description: Per: when the FiscalYear enters the closing state, auto-generate ClosingEntry records from every active ClosingEntryTemplate whose automationTrigger is on-close. For each matching template, sum the GL line balances inside the accountPattern range for this FY, create a ClosingEntry of the corresponding entryType (revenue-closing, expense-closing, accrual-reversal, …) with approvalStatus: pending-approval and automationTemplate: @template.templateId. When the template's reverseNextPeriod is true, generate a companion accrual-reversal ClosingEntry on the next FY (created as draft until the next FY activates). Per.

data.description: Reversal of @template.templateName from FY @self.yearNumber, generated alongside the closing entry.

onCloseMaterialiseRetainedEarnings.description: Per: on closing -> closed, materialise the RetainedEarnings record for this FY. Sums net income (revenue closing - expense closing) and rolls openingBalanceCents forward from the prior FY's closingBalanceCents. Links to the retained-earnings ClosingEntry that posts the equity-side transfer.

trialBalanceImbalanceCents.description: Item 1 backing aggregation: absolute difference (in cents) between debit and credit GL line totals for this FY's GLTransactions in posted state. Feeds the trial-balance-verified checklist precondition. Tolerance is enforced via the precondition's thresholdCents.
trialBalanceImbalanceCents.expression: ABS(SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'debit') - SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'credit'))

accrualReversalCoverage.description: Item 2 backing aggregation: count of ClosingEntry records with entryType in {accrual-reversal, manual} or JournalEntry with subType year-end-closing for this FY. Feeds the accruals-recorded checklist precondition.

accrualAccountBalanceCents.description: Helper aggregation: sum of cents balance on accrual accounts (default range 9700-9799) for this FY. Used by the accruals-recorded precondition's appliesWhen gate.
accrualAccountBalanceCents.expression: ABS(SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'credit') - SUM(GLLine.amountCents WHERE side = 'debit'))

depreciationClosingEntryCount.description: Item 3 backing aggregation: count of ClosingEntry records with entryType = depreciation for this FY. Feeds the depreciation-posted checklist precondition.

activeFixedAssetCount.description: Helper aggregation: count of FixedAsset records in lifecycleState = active for this administration. Used by the depreciation-posted precondition's appliesWhen gate.

foreignCurrencyFxCoverage.description: Item 4 backing aggregation: count of ClosingEntry records with currency != base currency for this FY (FX revaluation entries). Feeds the fx-declared checklist precondition.

foreignCurrencyAccountCount.description: Helper aggregation: count of GLTransaction records on this FY where currency differs from the administration's base currency (EUR by default). Used by the fx-declared precondition's appliesWhen gate.

relatedPartyUnacknowledgedCount.description: Item 5 backing aggregation: count of posted GLTransaction records flagged relatedParty = true but relatedPartyAcknowledged != true for this FY. Feeds the related-party-reviewed checklist precondition.

relatedPartyTransactionCount.description: Helper aggregation: count of posted GLTransaction records flagged relatedParty = true for this FY. Used by the related-party-reviewed precondition's appliesWhen gate.

netIncomeCents.description: Helper aggregation feeding the retained-earnings closing materialiser: sum of credit-side revenue (account range 4000-4999) minus debit-side expense (account range 5000-6999) for this FY in posted GL lines.
netIncomeCents.expression: SUM(CASE WHEN accountNumber BETWEEN 4000 AND 4999 THEN (CASE WHEN side = 'credit' THEN amountCents ELSE -amountCents END) WHEN accountNumber BETWEEN 5000 AND 6999 THEN (CASE WHEN side = 'debit' THEN -amountCents ELSE amountCents END) ELSE 0 END)

priorRetainedEarningsClosingCents.description: Helper aggregation feeding the retained-earnings closing materialiser: prior FY's RetainedEarnings.closingBalanceCents (0 for the very first FY).

distributionsCents.description: Helper aggregation feeding the retained-earnings closing materialiser: sum of distributions posted to the distribution-accounts range (default 9750-9799) for this FY. Operators override this range via the chart-of-accounts configuration.

balanceCarryforwardValid.description: Cross-FY balance-carryforward validation. Aggregation precondition on the next FY's open ->. activation: confirms the next FY's opening-balance GL postings match the prior FY's closing balances per balance-sheet account. Returns 0 if perfectly matched (within rounding tolerance); positive integer counts mismatched accounts.
balanceCarryforwardValid.failMessage: Balance carryforward: @value account(s) show a closing/opening mismatch greater than 1 cent. Re-run the opening-balance JournalEntry from the prior FY's close.

onReopen.description: Notify all administration admins when a fiscal year is reopened. A reopened closed year is a high-stakes audit event.
onReopen.title: Boekjaar heropend

ClosingEntry.title: Closing Entry
ClosingEntry.description: A manual or automated year-end closing entry. Tracks accrual postings, reversals, revenue/expense closings to the income-summary account, depreciation postings, retained-earnings rollforward, and opening-balance seeding. Materialises as a balanced GLTransaction via the JournalEntry materialisation pattern (T1) when approved and posted. All amounts are stored as integer-cent for money-safe arithmetic per the foundation cents-based money convention.

entryDate.title: Entry Date

entryType.description: Classification of the closing entry. Per.
entryType.title: Entry Type

description.description: Operator-authored description of the entry. Per.
description.example: Close revenue accounts 4000-4999 to income summary 9900
description.title: Description

automationTemplate.description: FK to ClosingEntryTemplate.templateId when this entry was generated automatically by a template. Per.
automationTemplate.title: Automation Template

amountCents.description: Total closing-entry amount in minor units of the currency (integer cents). Per. Money-safe arithmetic per the foundation cents-based convention.
amountCents.title: Amount Cents

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code of the closing entry amount.
currency.title: Currency

glTransactionId.description: Reference to the GLTransaction that materialised this closing entry when posted. Set by the lifecycle action on transition:post.
glTransactionId.title: GL Transaction ID

approvalStatus.description: Lifecycle state of the closing entry. draft -> pending-approval -> approved -> posted; or posted -> reversed. Per.
approvalStatus.title: Approval Status

approvedBy.description: Nextcloud user id of the financial officer / CFO who approved this closing entry. Per.
approvedBy.title: Approved By

approvedAt.title: Approved At

draft.description: Under construction. Editable. Not yet visible to approvers.

approved.label: Approved
approved.description: Approved by CFO / financial officer. Ready to post to the GL.

posted.label: Posted
posted.description: Materialised as a balanced GLTransaction. Immutable from the closing-entry side; reversed only via a compensating closing entry.

reversed.label: Reversed
reversed.description: Superseded by a compensating closing entry. Excluded from active reporting but remains queryable for audit.

submit.label: Submit for approval
submit.description: Bookkeeper submits the closing entry to the CFO for review.

approve.label: Approve
approve.description: CFO / financial-officer approves the closing entry.

reverse.label: Reverse

onPost.description: Materialise the approved closing entry as a balanced GLTransaction with matching GLLine rows. The lifecycle action mirrors the JournalEntry materialisation extension (T1). RetainedEarnings.title: Retained Earnings

Materialised via the FiscalYear close lifecycle (retained-earnings transfer JournalEntry) and linked to its driving ClosingEntry. Sub-ledger view onto the equity-side retained-earnings GL account. All amounts in integer cents (money-safe).

retainedEarningsId.description: Operator-stable identifier for this retained-earnings record. Per.
retainedEarningsId.title: Retained Earnings ID

fiscalYearId.description: Reference to the FiscalYear this record covers. One RetainedEarnings record per (fiscalYearId, administrationId). Per.

openingBalanceCents.title: Opening Balance Cents

netIncomeCents.description: Net income for the fiscal year (revenue minus expenses) in integer cents (signed; negative = net loss). Calculated as the income-summary closing balance after revenue and expense closing entries are posted. Per.
netIncomeCents.title: Net Income Cents

distributionsCents.description: Dividends or distributions paid out during the fiscal year in integer cents (non-negative). Deducted from net income for closing-balance calculation. Per.
distributionsCents.title: Distributions Cents

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency of the retained-earnings balances.

Supports time-bounded historicity via `effectiveFrom` so administrations can rotate their closing account across fiscal years if needed.

Each template matches a range of account numbers, transfers their balances to the configured closing account, and optionally reverses in the next period. Templates are consumed by the FiscalYear in-progress -> closed transition and by the ClosingEntry materialisation hook.

validate.requires: glCompleteness AND mappingCoverage AND mandatoryFieldsCheck AND glBalanceCheck

submit.label: Submit filing
submit.description: Operator confirms submission readiness. Filing contract (GL snapshot, mapping rules, XBRL metadata) is prepared for T4 outbound. No actual transmission in T3.

approve.label: Belastingdienst approved
approve.description: Webhook event from Belastingdienst marks the filing as accepted. Webhook payload logged to audit trail.

reject.label: Belastingdienst rejected
reject.description: Webhook event from Belastingdienst marks the filing as rejected. Rejection reason recorded.

revert.label: Revert to draft
revert.description: Operator reverts a validated filing to draft for further editing.

remediate.label: Remediate and revalidate
remediate.description: Operator addresses rejection reason and revalidates the filing.

glCompleteness.description: Check 1: all GL entries in the reporting period are assigned to accounts with an active XBRLMapping entry matching the selected taxonomy version. Returns true (pass) or list of unmapped account IDs (fail blocks draft→validated transition).

mappingCoverage.description: Check 2: all active Account records in the chart of accounts have at least one XBRLMapping entry for the active taxonomy version. Returns coverage percentage; warnings surfaced to operator.

mandatoryFieldsCheck.description: Check 3: FiscalYear.startDate and.endDate must be set; Administration.businessYear must match the fiscal year; SBRDocumentType.applicableEntityTypes must include the entity's business type.

checks.errorMessage: Entity type not eligible for this SBR filing type.

glBalanceCheck.description: Check 4: total GL debits must equal total GL credits per the standard GL invariant. Validates the double-entry invariant before filing.

unmappedAccounts.description: Queries all active Account records, checks XBRLMapping coverage per taxonomyVersion, returns list of unmapped account IDs. Idempotent and side-effect-free.

filingDeadlineReminder.description: Notify operators 30 days before filingDeadline when the administration's entity type is in applicableEntityTypes and the filing is not yet submitted.
filingDeadlineReminder._note: The applicableEntityTypes half of REQ-SBR-008 is not expressed here: it is a condition on the ADMINISTRATION, and a scheduled filter evaluates fields of the object it scans. The deadline window and the not-yet-submitted half are, so the rule now fires for the right documents and over-reaches only on entity type.
filingDeadlineReminder.message: Filing deadline reminder: {name} ({code}) is due on {filingDeadline}. Current status: {filingState}. Please complete and submit your SBR filing before the deadline.

disbursed.label: Uitbetaald

predicates.title: Predicates
